properties.entry: Plugin enabled (clear to temporarily stop sending receipts)
Loyalty server URL for accrual (full URL, e.g. https://loyalty.example.ru/api/v1/accruals)
Point identifier on the loyalty server (default: hypermarket)
App card number prefixes, comma separated (empty = any card except coupons and gift cards)
Send refund receipts to the server (to cancel accrued bonuses)
How many times to retry on server errors (connection failures are not counted)
